description: Traces Dorothy Crowfoot Hodgkin’s X-ray crystallographic research from hydrated protein crystals and sterols to penicillin, vitamin B12 and insulin. Explains the phase problem, electron-density reconstruction and collaborative laboratory work, and follows her efforts toward international scientific cooperation.
